  "reasoning": "All 16 answers are mathematically correct and supported by their own captured worked solutions. There is an explanatory source error in q-79278 and q-106711: for an ellipse with unequal semiaxes, the parameter theta is not generally the central polar angle of (x,y). The stated parameter intervals are nevertheless correct, so no field answer disagrees. Independently: q-117482 has area integral from -2 to 2 of (16-y^4), giving 256/5. q-79278 requires sin(theta) <= 0, and q-106711 additionally requires cos(theta) >= 0. q-114430 uses 1+tan^2(x)=sec^2(x); q-114467 reduces to sec^2(3x+2), whose antiderivative includes the factor 1/3. The ratios for q-40579, q-5457, q-67458, and q-124900 are respectively 27/8, -1/2, 3/2, and -0.3; convergence requires absolute ratio below 1. For q-124912 the ratios are -1, -3/4, and 1.1, so only II converges. For q-40277 they are 3/4, -1/8, and -2, so I and II converge. q-124924 requires 10^(k-2)<1, hence k<2; q-78490 requires 2^(6-k)<1, hence k>6. q-32706 gives dy/dx=1/(5y^4+3)=1/83 at y=2. For q-42258, BC=(8,-10)^T and A(BC)=(-68,-22,50)^T. For q-130313, AB=(-3,8,-7)^T, and its outer product with C gives the stated matrix. No earlier submissions or grades were supplied.",
